newsitem.title: FRANCE: Reuters French Advertising & Media Digest -June 20.
newsitem.headline: Reuters French Advertising & Media Digest -June 20.

text.p: REUTERS FRENCH ADVERTISING & MEDIA DIGEST
News from Reuters and the French press on Advertising, Marketing, Media, the Internet, Brand-name Products and People News.
ADVERTISING & MARKETING:

PARIS - Havas Advertising's plans for external growth will involve a dilution in parent Havas's stake, Havas Advertising Chairman Alain de Pouzilhac tells shareholders. The company is looking to a link with an "Anglo Saxon" advertising agency or network. (Reuter)

PARIS - Orangina's television spots for its Orangina sanguine blood orange drink, which casts the red fizzy drink as a bloodthirsty villain, was awarded "Grand prix" by Strategies magazine. The spot was producted by Young & Rubicam.
(Strategies)
PARIS - FCB's poster campaign for Mercedes, whose cars are overwhelmingly bought by men over 50, seeks to give the upmarket car a younger, less masculine image. (Le Figaro)
PARIS - The French advertising market is likely grow by five percent in 1997, Havas Advertising chairman Alain de Pouzilhac says. (Reuter)
MEDIA & THE INTERNET
PARIS - French magazine publisher Filipacchi Medias says its profits should rise in 1997, but it says the world advertising market is frail and could go either way. (Reuter)

PARIS - French Prime Minister Lionel Jospin says he will seek changes in the planned broadcasting law which will guarantee strong public television, create mechanisms to prevent over-concentration of ownership and strengthen the broadcasting watchdog, the Conseil Superieur de l'Audiovisuel (CSA).
(Reuter)
PARIS - Paris newsrooms get unconfirmed reports that Le Monde and its shareholders are preparing to buy L'Express, which Cie Generale des Eaux wants to sell. Le Monde declines to comment. (Les Echos)
BRAND-NAME PRODUCTS & MARKETS:

PARIS - A poll by IPSOS for the magazine Cuisine et Vins de France asks what domestic appliances the French need most. It finds over 90 percent of those interviewed see a freezer as very or fairly essential, while 53 percent give the same answer for a dishwasher. (Cuisine et Vins de France)
PARIS - France's LVMH raises its stake in Britain's Grand Metropolitan as part of a two-pronged attack to foil the planned Grand Met-Guinness merger, industry sources say. (Reuter)

PARIS - Japanese retail group Seibu has sold the Jean-Louis Scherrer fashion house to EK Finance, a French firm grouping designer clothing and shoe manufacturers, a spokeswoman for Scherrer says. (Reuter)
Paris Editorial, Sue Landau
For further information and news, see Reuters Advertising & Media Briefing. And visit us on the Internet at http://www.Bizinfo.reuters.com
